priorScope: Earlier Python STARTUPINFO lpDesktop assignments were not native desktop assignment evidence. Historical separateDesktop flags express intent only; isolation was unverified.
currentScope: CreateProcessW sets native lpDesktop. Each child self-attests its own thread desktop before UI; requested and observed names match. No SwitchDesktop or physical input.
baselineFailures: Earlier hangs included synchronous failure cleanup during dialog initialization; queued WM_CLOSE completes the expected failing baseline. They are not evidence of a new product deadlock.
historicalAssertions: Historical assertions remain reported as observed; isolation and hardware parity claims need separate revalidation.
